title: Influence of Phase Transitions in Indium-based catalysts for the catalytic performance in CO2 hydrogenation to methanol
extraction_notes: The Supporting Information contains no experimental catalyst-performance entries for CO2 hydrogenation to methanol. SI Table S1 reports Aspen Plus simulated gas-phase compositions/water pressures at assumed CO2 conversions, and SI Table S2 reports simulated gas feeds for in-situ XRD; these are simulations/characterisation conditions, not measured catalyst performance. SI Tables S3–S5 and SI Figures S1–S2 are catalyst characterisation data and are out of scope.
